segments.he: מִי שֶׁחָזָק בָּרָצוֹן סוֹף כָּל סוֹף יִהְיֶה אַחֲרִיתוֹ טוֹב.
segments.en: And through Tehillim [Psalms], which encompasses all forty-nine gates of teshuvah — which are the aspect of the forty-nine letters of the names of the Tribes, the forty-nine days of the Omer-counting, the forty-nine letters of Shema Yisrael and Baruch Shem — through this everything is rectified. For Tehillim was uttered by Dovid, King of Israel, who is the aspect of Moshiach who will merit to attain the Fiftieth Gate that encompasses everything. This is a wondrous intelligence, through which one merits to implant in the heart of Israel that they should always cry to G-d to restore them to Him. And through this very act it is reckoned as our own awakening — as if we ourselves are returning to Him from ourselves. For truly all of G-d's crying out to us, "Return to Me" — His intention is precisely this: that we should cry out to Him always: "Restore us to You, Hashem". It is found that in truth and in absolute truth, there is no disagreement or difference at all between the Knesses Yisrael and G-d — only that neither party understands the other's holy intention. And all this is because the Fiftieth Gate has not yet been revealed. But through Tehillim, the illumination of the Fiftieth Gate is drawn down — which encompasses everything from below upward and from above downward — until we merit to cry to Him always in whatever manner, and through this everything will be rectified.

segments.he: וְכָל מִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה לְהִתְחַזֵּק בָּזֶה לִהְיוֹת רְצוֹנוֹ חָזָק תָּמִיד אֶל הָאֱמֶת וְלא יַרְפֶּה אֶת הָרָצוֹן הַטּוֹב אֲפִלּוּ אִם יַעֲבר עָלָיו מָה, בְּוַדַּאי סוֹף כָּל סוֹף יִהְיֶה אַחֲרִיתוֹ טוֹב. שֶׁעַל זֶה אָמַר תָּמוּת נַפְשִׁי מוֹת יְשָׁרִים הַלָּלוּ וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתִי כָּמוֹהוּ. כִּי אָמַר עַל עַצְמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַע קִלְקוּלוֹ וְזֻהֲמָתוֹ הָעֲצוּמָה שֶׁאֵין דֻּגְמָתוֹ כַּנַּ"ל, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אָמַר הַלְוַאי וְהָיִיתִי זוֹכֶה אֲפִלּוּ אָנכִי לֵילֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ זֶה לְהִתְחַזֵּק מֵעַתָּה בִּרְצוֹנוֹת טוֹבִים וּלְפָרֵשׁ שִׂיחָתִי בְּכָל יוֹם לְפָנָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ וְלִשְׁפּט אֶת עַצְמִי בְּכָל עֵת בַּבְּחִינָה הַנַּ"ל, אָז הָיִיתִי זוֹכֶה גַּם כֵּן לְאַחֲרִית טוֹב בִּבְחִינַת וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתִי כָּמוֹהוּ.
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the ten kinds of melody with which the book of Tehillim was said.

segments.he: וְכָל זֶה אָמַר מֵחֲמַת הַהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁעִקֵּם ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ אֶת פִּיו לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְחַזְּקָם בִּרְצוֹנוֹת טוֹבִים וְהִתְבּוֹדְדוּת שֶׁיִּהְיוּ חֲזָקִים בָּזֶה לְעוֹלָם. וּמִזֶּה אָנוּ מְבִינִים מֶה הָיָה בְּדַעְתּוֹ לְהֵפֶךְ לַחֲלק עַל כָּל זֶה וּלְרַחֲקָם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מִכָּל זֶה עַל יְדֵי דִּבּוּרָיו וְלֵיצָנוּת שֶׁלּוֹ וְכוּ' הָרָעִים, אַךְ ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּרַחֲמָיו הָפַךְ הַקְּלָלָה לִבְרָכָה עַד שֶׁהֻכְרַח לְבָרְכָם וּלְחַזְּקָם בְּהָאֱמֶת כַּנַּ"ל. (שָׁם):
segments.en: For it is found in the words of our Master, Teacher, and Rebbe, of blessed memory, in Likutay Moharan I:237, that the essential union [between the soul and G-d] comes about through melody — in the aspect of "This time my husband will join himself to me" [Bereishis 29:34], said when Levi was born — for those who engage in song upon the platform. See there. That is, melody and song in the aspect of Tehillim — through this is the essential union of the Knesses Yisrael with her Beloved. For the essential distance, Heaven forfend, is on account of the above-mentioned debate. Israel want G-d to arouse them first and return them to Him. And He wants the Knesses Yisrael to awaken first. But through the saying of Tehillim, which encompasses all ten kinds of melody from above downward and from below upward — in the aspect of "a psalm of Dovid" and "of Dovid a psalm" — and our Sages, of blessed memory, said that sometimes he would utter song and afterward the holy spirit would rest upon him, and sometimes the reverse, that the holy spirit would rest upon him first and afterward he would utter song — that is, as above, that the Psalms of Tehillim encompass both aspects: both when arousal from below precedes, and when arousal from above precedes. Therefore, through Tehillim, the essential union and drawing-close of Israel to their Father in Heaven comes about — since through it both awakenings are included together. For Tehillim awakens the heart of Israel to long for G-d — and this is reckoned as our awakening, even though in truth everything comes from Him.
